# Exact-Source 557-Muscle Excitation Diagnostic

Issue #12182 adds a separately versioned, source-exact diagnostic to the
constrained OpenSim muscle replay pathway. The strict version-two pathway
continues to reject external files, complex CustomJoint functions, wraps,
conditional and moving path points. Version three admits only the derived
BUET–Hamner XML SHA-256
`453e09c4e42dcc3f4b74a3b2efeff063e96c3820b3eee1efe95eef249579010d`
and its OpenSim 4.6 loaded component/path digest. A change to a law, range,
muscle path, constraint, flag or source byte needs a new reviewed profile.
This is a diagnostic replay policy, not an anatomy or physiological approval.

## Source and Initial-State Contracts

The frozen XML has 557 Thelen muscles, 56 coordinates, 17 native couplers,
29 CustomJoints, 58 ConditionalPathPoints, 8 MovingPathPoints, 233 PathWraps,
22 WrapCylinders, and 40 source-clamped coordinate ranges. The exact
path/class inventory contains 6,691 components. Four `Coordinate.Coupled`
coordinates are mapped to radians only after verifying their exact source
paths drive native rotational transform axes; the generic v1 schema still
rejects unknown coupled-coordinate units. All 106 `mesh_file` declarations
are under attached `Mesh` rendering geometry on bodies or offset frames.
Their filenames and locations are bound; absent VTP files cannot be promoted
to dynamic resources or treated as rendered-geometry qualification. Any other
file reference, contact geometry, controller, prescribed motion, or
non-muscle force rejects.

The named seed is the retained single-equilibrium v2 observation SHA-256
`21f1095267f1b0d476c39df655118f134da2e7292aada7a4b9d0c45e9b9eca9b`.
Exactly 1,226 common continuous values survive the three explicit joint
reductions from its 1,238 source values. The first direct attempt kept those
values and source bounds; at the first 1 ms replay sample `SC_z` moved below
its source lower bound zero. That failed attempt is retained. A second
declared diagnostic seed moves only six initially bound-sitting coordinate
**values** inward by 0.1% of each source range: bilateral `SC_z`, elbow
flexion and pronation/supination. It does not alter speeds, muscle activation,
fiber states, source XML, bounds, constraints, gravity, or force laws. No
post-restoration assembly or muscle equilibrium is used. All 17 native
couplers and the 40 exact source-clamped ranges are checked at each sampled
state. This seed adjustment is a numerical diagnostic, not a measured pose.

## Saved Input and Native Replay

The version-three T01 envelope binds complete named and registered native
state, source and loaded model, provider/profile hashes, ordered 557 muscle
channels, linear time-only excitation knots, and the declared constraint
policy. The existing scalar executor uses an owned OpenSim Manager; it rejects
an initialization that changes the requested state or clock. It saves actual
native excitation and force separately. For sample $k$ the independent
fresh-model replay tests

$$x_{k+1}=F_{\mathrm{OpenSim}}(x_k,e(t),\pi),\qquad
e_i(t)=\operatorname{linear}(e_{i,k},e_{i,k+1}),$$

where $\pi$ includes the exact source and native constraint policy. No
observation is fed back into the input player and no state is reset between
samples. With the diagnostic interior seed and frozen $e_i=0.05$, two fresh
replays on $[0,0.1,0.2]$ ms have zero maximum named-state and muscle-force
differences. Native QErr is at most $6.28\times10^{-17}$ and UErr at most
$1.60\times10^{-14}$ in their respective native units. Changing one final
excitation knot preserves the pre-change state and changes that muscle's
terminal activation by $5.77\times10^{-4}$; input payload digests differ.
The source-bound receipt preserves exact values and reproduction commands.

The horizon is only **0.2 ms**. The original source seed fails the 1 ms
chart gate, and a 2 ms attempt with the interior seed also fails it. Four
source-body inertia tensors have separate unresolved physical-validity
findings. Successful saved-input replay does not establish complete SimTK
restart, meaningful swing duration, Moco solve, passive-force physiology,
source anatomy, visual-resource availability, contact/grip, calibrated marker
correspondence, private-capture tracking or six-engine parity. All 17 required
variant rows remain in the epic denominator; the calculation registry and
publication approval remain blocked.
